Judgment call: this is a demo/platform paper. It is not a survey or a pure dataset description, and it concerns graph RAG. The abstract says "we show how GraphContainer enables controlled comparisons of various graph formats and retrieval strategies," which suggests some evaluation of RAG methods, but the experiments are not clearly stated. Under the rules, a tool/resource with no new experiments would fall under E2, but that is not clear here. The safest decision is MAYBE.
